threads.body: `request_input` can be a string or dict (OpenAI Responses allows `input` to be a string, array, etc.). As written, iterating over a string will yield characters and `item.get(...)` will raise an AttributeError. Normalize `input` to a list of dict-like items (or empty list) before checking for `function_call_output`.

replies.body: Applied in eavanvalkenburg/semantic-conventions-genai@9e410b5. The Responses input is now normalized to dict-like list items before checking for function_call_output.

threads.body: For Responses-style tool definitions, the tool name is typically under `tool["function"]["name"]` (similar to the chat-completions mock above). Using `tool.get("name")` will usually be `None`, which makes the mock ignore any non-default tool name the client sends.

replies.body: Applied in eavanvalkenburg/semantic-conventions-genai@9e410b5. The Responses tool name now checks both the top-level Responses shape and the nested function.name shape.
